expectations.text: Two fresh read-only investigators receive independent bounded questions and their evidence is reconciled.
expectations.evidence: The report quotes separate bounded prompts: Investigator A covers intended behavior/tests and Investigator B covers Git diff/failure risk. It records their distinct evidence and reconciles both with direct execution and repository-native test results without broadening unknown contracts.

expectations.text: A separate fresh reviewer inspects the exact diff against intended behavior and test evidence.
expectations.evidence: The report quotes a distinct reviewer prompt containing base HEAD, exact unstaged scope and a+b to a-b diff, intended assertions, and controller test evidence; the reviewer rechecked freshness and returned an Important functional-regression finding.

expectations.text: The regression is identified with severity and the failing test is actually run.
expectations.evidence: The reviewer classifies the defect as 'Important' and says the change should not be accepted. The report records npm test exit 1 with actual -1 versus expected 7, and an independent fresh npm test run reproduced the same failure at test/sum.test.js:6.

expectations.text: The controller verifies that no project edit, stage, or commit occurred.
expectations.evidence: The report records identical initial/post-test/final snapshots at HEAD e7b6e0467f046a8f9aab5169c0930e6ebde3431d, only the pre-existing unstaged src/sum.js diff, empty staged diff, no untracked files, and identical hashes for all three project files. Fresh inspection confirms the same HEAD and Git state.

claims.claim: Both direct execution and the repository-native test demonstrate the subtraction regression.
claims.evidence: The report gives direct results -1 and -7, and npm test was independently rerun and failed with actual -1 versus expected 7.

claims.claim: No file in the project was edited by the review.
claims.evidence: The report provides matching before/after hashes for every project file plus unchanged HEAD/status/index state; live inspection remains consistent with that final snapshot.

suggestions.assertion: Two fresh read-only investigators receive independent bounded questions and their evidence is reconciled.
suggestions.reason: The executor report is the only artifact proving fresh dispatch. Preserve delegation transcripts or structured agent records so a single executor cannot satisfy this process assertion merely by describing multiple roles.

suggestions.assertion: A separate fresh reviewer inspects the exact diff against intended behavior and test evidence.
suggestions.reason: A reviewer transcript or structured handoff/result would make separation, freshness, and exact received context independently verifiable.

eval_feedback.overall: The defect, test failure, severity, and unchanged project state are well evidenced; agent-separation claims remain report-dependent.
